# Plan: Fix the wrong date expectation

## Goal
`tests/format.test.mjs` expects `"12/31/2026"`, but `formatDate` intentionally emits ISO dates (`date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)` → `YYYY-MM-DD`). The test is wrong; fix the expectation and leave `lib/` untouched.

## Analysis
`formatDate(new Date("2026-12-31"))`: date-only strings parse as UTC midnight, so `toISOString()` yields `2026-12-31T00:00:00.000Z` and slicing gives `"2026-12-31"` — deterministic regardless of local timezone. The correct expectation is therefore `"2026-12-31"`.

## Changes
1. `tests/format.test.mjs`
   - Change the asserted value from `"12/31/2026"` to `"2026-12-31"`. Nothing else in the file changes.

## Order of work
1. Update the expectation.
2. Run `node --test`; the format test must pass.
3. Confirm no file under `lib/` was modified.

## Done when
- The test asserts the ISO output and passes.
- `lib/format.mjs` is unchanged.
